notes: Generic category illustrations represent the named merchants; they are not official logos. Scanner photograph is a staged beauty checkout with a fictitious QR-like pattern. Existing Swiggy logo is reused from hub-dashboard assets. No image changes shared component styling.

assets.prompt: Photorealistic staged smartphone-camera view of a contemporary Indian beauty store checkout counter. Portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio. A clean upright white payment placard centered, with a large black fictitious QR-like square pattern occupying its middle, visible straight-on; illustrative pattern only, no real payment details. Placard centered about 53 percent down the image and about 64 percent of image width. Softly out-of-focus peach, pink and neutral beauty product packaging on shelves behind it; warm daylight, natural subtle depth of field, polished cream counter, premium but everyday shop atmosphere. No readable words, logos, watermarks, hands, people, screen UI or phone frame. Crisp contrasting black and white square pattern, believable quiet surroundings, no blue graphic banner.
